one_line_product_description: Document Protocol Lab is a bounded, evidence-first SEC Item 1A pilot for seeing how a document workflow answers first, keeps evidence nearby, and opens audit on demand.
short_subhead: Current live pilot: three SEC Item 1A fixtures, NVDA, LLY, and KO.
current_coverage_statement: The current visible pilot stays fixed to three FY2024 to FY2025 Item 1A fixtures: NVDA, LLY, and KO.
three_case_mix_usefulness_statement: NVDA gives the clearest first filing answer, LLY tests the protocol in a bounded policy-heavy setting, and KO checks whether the same workflow stays honest on a mostly stable filing.
where_to_start_statement: Start with NVDA for the strongest first read, LLY for policy and pricing contrast, or KO for the restraint check.
external_demo_blurb: Document Protocol Lab currently ships a compact SEC Item 1A pilot across NVDA, LLY, and KO.
